The '''CS20 Board Plate''' was a control lock panel manufactured by [[VargeCorp/Legends|VargeCorp]]. Consisting of a large metal plate form-molded to match the contours of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] control panel, the CS20 Board Plate was slid into place and sealed off access to the console. The mechanism locked off access to the ship's instruments, [[Computer/Legends|computers]], and flight controls. The plate could be removed by keying in an electronic combination, or using a [[Keycard/Legends|keycard]].<ref name="PSG" />
